package.description: Local, offline RAG assistant that searches your own documents and answers questions with sources - no cloud.

en-US.description: Local, offline RAG assistant that searches your own documents and answers questions with sources - no cloud.
en-US.longDescription:
A local RAG system (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) for Windows: import
PDFs (scanned ones via built-in OCR), Word, Excel, text, images and OTRS
ticket exports, search them by meaning and
keywords, and get concise AI answers with source citations - generated by a
local language model (llama.cpp), fully on your own machine. No cloud, no
telemetry; after setup it runs offline. Free for private individuals and
small businesses (PolyForm Small Business License).
en-US.name: SWX KI-Assistent
